title: Choose an option
summary: IonSelect offers a controlled list of choices.
introduction: IonSelect offers a controlled list of choices. Your task: Add a history option.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for choose an option

blocks.text: IonSelect offers a controlled list of choices. onIonChange gives the selected value.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.title: Choose an option

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `IonSelect` uses its option values for the chosen state. The visible option label can be different.
`useState` gives React a remembered value and a setter. Call the setter to ask React to show the next value.
`IonContent` owns the Ionic screen's scrolling content area. It works inside the starter app's page structure.

blocks.text: The current book type changes after a selection.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use stable option values rather than depending on their visible position.
